rubric_sets.name: SME Rubric v1
rubric_sets.description: SME rubric for organization, presentation, and assessment.

criteria.title: Topic Coherence
criteria.description: Topics are coherent from Unit to Chapter.
criteria.scoring_rule: If there are fewer than 4 topic-to-topic transitions total, score by issue count instead (a short module with 0 issues is coherent, not deficient): 0 issues -> 4, 1 -> 3, 2 -> 2, 3+ issues -> 1. Otherwise (4+ transitions), score the percentage of transitions that are coherent (each topic logically follows the last) on the moderate scale: 4 if >=80%, 3 if >=50%, 2 if >=20%, else 1. No topics at all -> 1.

criteria.title: Interactivity
criteria.description: Material is interactive in each lesson which makes life-long learning easier.
criteria.scoring_rule: Count genuine interactive elements with real task content (not just a label like 'Activity 1' with no actual task). Score: 4+ elements -> 4, 2-3 -> 3, 1 -> 2, 0 -> 1.

criteria.title: Clear Directions
criteria.description: Directions are clear and complete enough for students to perform required tasks.
criteria.scoring_rule: Score the percentage of tasks with clear, complete directions on the moderate scale: 4 if >=80%, 3 if >=50%, 2 if >=20%, else 1.

criteria.title: Accurate Sections
criteria.description: Paragraphs and sections have clear and accurate information.
criteria.scoring_rule: Score the percentage of sections that are clear and internally consistent (no contradictions or garbled content) on the moderate scale: 4 if >=80%, 3 if >=50%, 2 if >=20%, else 1.

criteria.title: Enhancement Activities
criteria.description: Enhancement activities for students are provided.
criteria.scoring_rule: Count genuine enhancement activities beyond the core lesson content. Score: 3+ activities -> 4, 2 -> 3, 1 -> 2, 0 -> 1.

criteria.title: Learner Transformation
criteria.description: Students are engaged in transforming what they learn.
criteria.scoring_rule: Score the percentage of tasks that engage higher-order thinking (apply/analyze/evaluate/create, not just remember/understand) on the moderate scale: 4 if >=80%, 3 if >=50%, 2 if >=20%, else 1. No tasks found -> 1.

criteria.title: Varied Assessment Tools
criteria.description: Teachers can easily assess students' progress by using varied assessment tools.
criteria.scoring_rule: Count distinct assessment TYPES used (objective test, written, reflection, performance task, project, oral, self-assessment). Score: 5+ types -> 4, 3-4 types -> 3, 2 types -> 2, <=1 type -> 1.

criteria.title: Progress Monitoring
criteria.description: The material keeps an on-going record of students' progress and allows the teacher to monitor student performance.
criteria.scoring_rule: Count genuine progress-monitoring mechanisms, spanning up to 4 types (checkpoint, self-assessment, reflection, cumulative). Score: 4+ mechanisms -> 4, 2-3 -> 3, 1 -> 2, 0 -> 1.

criteria.title: Prescriptive Feedback
criteria.description: Positive, meaningful feedback, and prescriptive guides for interventions are provided.
criteria.scoring_rule: Count distinct feedback/intervention mechanism TYPES (answer key, rubric, remediation referral, positive reinforcement). Score: 3-4 types -> 4, 2 types -> 3, 1 type -> 2, 0 types -> 1.

criteria.title: Objective Gauging
criteria.description: Objectives are gauged effectively.
criteria.scoring_rule: Score the percentage of stated objectives that are measured by a real assessment on the moderate scale: 4 if >=80%, 3 if >=50%, 2 if >=20%, else 1. No objectives found -> 1.

rubric_sets.name: GAD Rubric v1
rubric_sets.description: GAD rubric for inclusivity and gender sensitivity.

criteria.title: Free from Stereotypes
criteria.description: The material is free from gender stereotypes.
criteria.scoring_rule: Count each unique instance of gender stereotypes or gender-biased representations — content that reinforces stereotypes about gender roles, abilities, behaviors, occupations, or characteristics, or that explicitly or implicitly portrays one gender using stereotypical assumptions. Do NOT count discussions of gender stereotypes presented for educational, analytical, historical, or critical purposes, or gender-neutral content. Count each unique instance once.

criteria.title: Equal Representation
criteria.description: The material shows females and males an equal number of times.
criteria.scoring_rule: Count meaningful female and male representations: named individuals, names listed under a gender-labeled group or heading, characters, illustrations depicting people, examples or case studies involving people, explicit gender references (woman, man, girl, boy, female, male), and gender-specific pronouns (she, her, he, him). Count each meaningful representation once within the same discussion, example, or scenario; if the same individual appears in different examples, count each appearance separately. Do NOT infer gender when it is ambiguous, and ignore gender-neutral references.

criteria.title: Equal Respect
criteria.description: The material shows females and males with equal respect, and potential.
criteria.scoring_rule: Count each unique instance that portrays one gender as less capable, less respected, less deserving, or as having fewer opportunities than another. Do NOT count discussions of discrimination presented for educational, analytical, historical, or critical purposes. Count each unique instance once.

criteria.title: Reflects Experiences
criteria.description: The material reflects the needs and life experiences of both male and female students.
criteria.scoring_rule: Count each unique instance where the material excludes one gender's experiences, disproportionately favors one gender's experiences, or assumes that activities, roles, responsibilities, interests, or aspirations belong primarily to one gender. Do NOT count gender-neutral examples or discussions presented for educational, analytical, historical, or critical purposes. Count each unique instance once.

criteria.title: Promotes Equality
criteria.description: The material promotes peace and equality for males and females, regardless of their race, class, disability, religion, sexual preference, or ethnic background.
criteria.scoring_rule: Count each unique instance of discriminatory, prejudicial, exclusionary, or inequality-promoting content related to gender, race, social class, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or ethnic background. Do NOT count historical, educational, analytical, or critical discussions of discrimination. Count each unique instance once.

rubric_sets.name: ITSO Rubric v1
rubric_sets.description: ITSO rubric for intellectual property and data privacy.

domains.title: Intellectual Property and Data Privacy Act

criteria.title: No IP Issue
criteria.description: The material has no intellectual property issue, such as plagiarism.

criteria.title: Proper References
criteria.description: The material includes reference section where the sources are properly acknowledged.

criteria.title: Faculty Ownership
criteria.description: The material ensures the freedom of the faculty to retain ownership of the teaching materials.

criteria.title: Student Confidentiality
criteria.description: The material includes confidentiality of student information.

criteria.title: Teacher and Student Rights
criteria.description: The material secures the right of the teacher and students.
